id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

trackingIdForImport.description: This ID is used to determine which import this entity belongs to.

parent.description:
The {@link AssetClass} of the asset that is recommended to contain or be a parent of an asset with {@link AssetClass}
equal to {@link AssetClassParentChildRelation#child}.

child.description:
The {@link AssetClass} of the asset that is recommended to be contained by or be a child of
an asset with {@link AssetClass} equal to {@link AssetClassParentChildRelation#parent}.

title:
Represents a many to many parent child relation between two {@link AssetClass}es.
More specifically, the `parent` asset class is recommended to contain or be a parent of
an asset with `child` asset class.

Practically, this relation is used to recommend adding certain types (encoded by {@link AssetClass}) of
{@link ReliabilityAsset} under other {@link ReliabilityAsset}s. For example, an Car asset should contain a
Engine asset, so a relation with parent = Car and child = Engine is created.
name: AssetClassParentChildRelation
